mdSummary:
# FlowCanvas

Node/flow editor canvas — templated nodes, SVG edges, pan, pointer-anchored wheel zoom, node drag with snapping, background grid and zoom controls.

**Package:** `Lumeo.Flow` · **Category:** Data Display
**Docs:** https://lumeo.nativ.sh/components/flow-canvas

## Parameters
| Owner | Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FlowCanvas | Nodes | `IReadOnlyList<FlowNode>?` | `` | The nodes to render. Two-way bindable (@bind-Nodes): every committed drag or keyboard move emits a new list through NodesChanged. Without a binding the canvas keeps its own copy until you pass a different list. |
| FlowCanvas | NodesChanged | `EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<FlowNode>>` | `` | Raised with the new node list after a committed drag or keyboard move. |
| FlowCanvas | Edges | `IReadOnlyList<FlowEdge>?` | `` | The edges to draw between nodes. Edges whose source or target node is missing are skipped. |
| FlowCanvas | Viewport | `FlowViewport` | `new(0, 0, 1)` | The pan/zoom state. Two-way bindable (@bind-Viewport). Setting a new value moves the canvas; the canvas reports user pans and zooms back through ViewportChanged. A zoom of 0 or less means "not set" (the canvas starts at 0,0 and 100%). |
| FlowCanvas | ViewportChanged | `EventCallback<FlowViewport>` | `` | Raised when the viewport changes — at most once per animation frame while a pan or wheel zoom is running, once more when it ends, and after every imperative change (FitViewAsync, ZoomInAsync, ...). |
| FlowCanvas | NodeTemplate | `RenderFragment<FlowNodeContext>?` | `` | Renders each node's content. The canvas wraps it in a positioned, focusable host. Without a template a node renders a small card with its Data (or Id). |
| FlowCanvas | ChildContent | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Overlays rendered inside the pane: FlowBackground, FlowControls, your own panels. |
| FlowCanvas | Height | `string` | `"500px"` | CSS height of the canvas. |
| FlowCanvas | MinZoom | `double` | `0.25` | Smallest zoom a gesture or method may reach. |
| FlowCanvas | MaxZoom | `double` | `2` | Largest zoom a gesture or method may reach. |
| FlowCanvas | FitViewOnInit | `bool` | `true` | Fits every node into view once the canvas has mounted and measured its nodes (the nodes stay invisible until then, so the un-fitted frame never shows). |
| FlowCanvas | FitViewPadding | `double` | `0.1` | Breathing room for fit-view, as a fraction of the nodes' bounds (0.1 = 10%). |
| FlowCanvas | SnapToGrid | `bool` | `false` | Snaps dragged and keyboard-moved nodes to SnapGrid. |
| FlowCanvas | SnapGrid | `(double X, double Y)` | `(16, 16)` | The snap grid in flow units (X, Y). |
| FlowCanvas | NodesDraggable | `bool` | `true` | Nodes can be moved by dragging or with the arrow keys. |
| FlowCanvas | PanOnDrag | `bool` | `true` | Dragging the empty background pans the canvas. Holding Space pans from anywhere either way. |
| FlowCanvas | ZoomOnScroll | `bool` | `true` | The mouse wheel zooms, anchored on the pointer (a plain wheel — no modifier — like React Flow; the page does not scroll while the pointer is over the canvas). |
| FlowCanvas | Readonly | `bool` | `false` | Turns every editing gesture off (node drag and keyboard move now; connect and delete in later phases). Pan, zoom, selection and click events keep working. |
| FlowCanvas | OnNodeClick | `EventCallback<FlowNode>` | `` | A node was clicked (not raised for the click that ends a drag). |
| FlowCanvas | OnNodeDoubleClick | `EventCallback<FlowNode>` | `` | A node was double-clicked. |
| FlowCanvas | OnNodeContextMenu | `EventCallback<FlowNodeContextMenuEventArgs>` | `` | A node was right-clicked. The browser menu is suppressed while this has a handler. |
| FlowCanvas | OnPaneClick | `EventCallback<FlowPoint>` | `` | The empty background was clicked (not dragged); the point is in flow coordinates. |
| FlowCanvas | OnNodeDragStop | `EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<FlowNodeChange>>` | `` | A drag (or arrow-key move) was committed; one entry per moved node. Raised after NodesChanged. |
| FlowCanvas | Class | `string?` | `` | Additional CSS classes merged onto the root element. |
| FlowCanvas | AdditionalAttributes | `Dictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Captures unmatched attributes and applies them to the root element. |
| FlowBackground | Context | `FlowCanvas.FlowCanvasContext?` | `` |  |
| FlowBackground | Variant | `FlowBackgroundVariant` | `FlowBackgroundVariant.Dots` | What the grid draws. |
| FlowBackground | Gap | `double` | `20` | Grid spacing in flow units. |
| FlowBackground | Size | `double` | `1` | Dot radius (dots) or half the arm length (cross), in flow units. Ignored for lines. |
| FlowBackground | Class | `string?` | `` | Additional CSS classes merged onto the background \<svg\>. |
| FlowBackground | AdditionalAttributes | `Dictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Captures unmatched attributes and applies them to the background \<svg\>. |
| FlowControls | Context | `FlowCanvas.FlowCanvasContext?` | `` |  |
| FlowControls | Position | `ControlsPosition` | `ControlsPosition.BottomLeft` | The corner the controls sit in. |
| FlowControls | Horizontal | `bool` | `false` | Lays the buttons out in a row instead of a column. |
| FlowControls | ShowZoom | `bool` | `true` | Shows the zoom in / zoom out buttons. |
| FlowControls | ShowFitView | `bool` | `true` | Shows the fit-view button. |
| FlowControls | ShowLock | `bool` | `true` | Shows the lock toggle (locked = nodes cannot be moved; pan and zoom still work). |
| FlowControls | ChildContent | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Extra buttons appended after the built-in ones. |
| FlowControls | Class | `string?` | `` | Additional CSS classes merged onto the toolbar. |
| FlowControls | AdditionalAttributes | `Dictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Captures unmatched attributes and applies them to the toolbar. |
| FlowEdgeLayer | Context | `FlowCanvas.FlowCanvasContext?` | `` |  |
| FlowEdgeLayer | Class | `string?` | `` | Additional CSS classes merged onto the edge layer's \<svg\>. |
| FlowEdgeLayer | AdditionalAttributes | `Dictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Captures unmatched attributes and applies them to the edge layer's \<svg\>. |
| FlowHandle | Node | `FlowNode?` | `` |  |
| FlowHandle | Type | `FlowHandleType` | `FlowHandleType.Source` | Source (edges start here) or target (edges end here). |
| FlowHandle | Position | `FlowPosition` | `FlowPosition.Right` | The side of the node the handle sits on, and the direction edges leave/enter it. |
| FlowHandle | Id | `string?` | `` | Handle id, for nodes with several handles of the same type (matched by FlowEdge.SourceHandle/TargetHandle). |
| FlowHandle | Class | `string?` | `` | Additional CSS classes merged onto the handle button. |
| FlowHandle | AdditionalAttributes | `Dictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Captures unmatched attributes and applies them to the handle button. |
| FlowNodeHost | Context | `FlowCanvas.FlowCanvasContext?` | `` |  |
| FlowNodeHost | Node | `FlowNode` | `default!` | The node this host positions and wraps. |
| FlowNodeHost | Class | `string?` | `` | Additional CSS classes merged onto the host element. |
| FlowNodeHost | AdditionalAttributes | `Dictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Captures unmatched attributes and applies them to the host element. |

## Slots
- `NodeTemplate` (FlowCanvas) — Renders each node's content. The canvas wraps it in a positioned, focusable host. Without a template a node renders a small card with its Data (or Id).
- `ChildContent` (FlowCanvas) — Overlays rendered inside the pane: FlowBackground, FlowControls, your own panels.
- `ChildContent` (FlowControls) — Extra buttons appended after the built-in ones.

## Events
- `NodesChanged` (`EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<FlowNode>>`) — Raised with the new node list after a committed drag or keyboard move.
- `ViewportChanged` (`EventCallback<FlowViewport>`) — Raised when the viewport changes — at most once per animation frame while a pan or wheel zoom is running, once more when it ends, and after every imperative change (FitViewAsync, ZoomInAsync, ...).
- `OnNodeClick` (`EventCallback<FlowNode>`) — A node was clicked (not raised for the click that ends a drag).
- `OnNodeDoubleClick` (`EventCallback<FlowNode>`) — A node was double-clicked.
- `OnNodeContextMenu` (`EventCallback<FlowNodeContextMenuEventArgs>`) — A node was right-clicked. The browser menu is suppressed while this has a handler.
- `OnPaneClick` (`EventCallback<FlowPoint>`) — The empty background was clicked (not dragged); the point is in flow coordinates.
- `OnNodeDragStop` (`EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<FlowNodeChange>>`) — A drag (or arrow-key move) was committed; one entry per moved node. Raised after NodesChanged.

## Sub-components
- `FlowBackground`, `FlowControls`, `FlowEdgeLayer`, `FlowHandle`, `FlowNodeHost`

## Cascading values it expects
- `Context` (`FlowCanvas.FlowCanvasContext?`)
- `Node` (`FlowNode?`)

## Services it injects
- `IComponentInteropService` (Lumeo.Services)
- `ILumeoLocalizer` (Lumeo.Services.Localization)

## Keyboard
- `Escape` — HandleNodeKeyDownAsync handles Escape in FlowCanvas.razor
- `ArrowLeft` — HandleNodeKeyDownAsync handles ArrowLeft in FlowCanvas.razor
- `ArrowRight` — HandleNodeKeyDownAsync handles ArrowRight in FlowCanvas.razor
- `ArrowUp` — HandleNodeKeyDownAsync handles ArrowUp in FlowCanvas.razor
- `ArrowDown` — HandleNodeKeyDownAsync handles ArrowDown in FlowCanvas.razor

## Example
```razor
<FlowCanvas />
```

## CSS variables
`--color-accent`, `--color-accent-foreground`, `--color-background`, `--color-border`, `--color-card`, `--color-card-foreground`, `--color-foreground`, `--radius`
